collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A hen settles into a sunny spot beside the cooking fire.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: A hen settles into a sunny spot beside the cooking fire. The cook carefully works around her for the rest of the morning.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: A hen settles into a sunny spot beside the cooking fire. She clucks contentedly at every new smell from the pot.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: A hen settles into a sunny spot beside the cooking fire. A child tries to move her, and she flaps away in indignation.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: A hen settles into a sunny spot beside the cooking fire. She falls asleep so soundly that nobody has the heart to disturb her.
